assetStatus: Already implemented — a hand-built React Three Fiber scene (EarthSpaceViewer.tsx, mode="eclipses"), not a pending asset. Earth and the Moon render from the same real, already-cleared GLBs used elsewhere in Space.
visualStyleNotes: Anatomy Atelier quality bar: warm off-white studio backdrop, no floor grid, no glow/bloom. Sun, Earth and Moon are arranged along the current alignment offset with the Moon's real 5.1° orbital tilt toggleable; the shadow-strength readout (total/partial/none) updates live as the offset slider moves.
materialNotes: Earth and Moon use their existing real GLB material sets (metallic-roughness PBR); no emissive channels — alignment quality is read from the offset slider and the side-panel readout, not a rendered shadow-fade effect.
note: Process-driven component: the 'Touch it' interaction is a live physics simulation (eclipse-type toggle, alignment-offset slider, tilt toggle) rather than tapping points on a single model, so this component intentionally carries no hotspots.
